en: The postcard consists of two sides. The front side is a black-and-white photograph showing a busy public square with market stalls, horse-drawn carriages, pedestrians, and ornate 19th-century European buildings surrounding the square. Clear signage in Swedish is present. In the foreground there is a statue on a pedestal. Text at the bottom of the image reads 'Sundsvall, Torget.' The reverse side contains handwritten text in Swedish, two Swedish 5 öre stamps featuring a royal portrait, and is addressed to someone in Stockholm, Sweden.
